title: Program
description: A compiled VDBE program. See spec/vdbe-opcodes.spec.md § 'Well-formedness' for invariants every compiled program must satisfy.

opcodes.description: Linear sequence of opcodes. Last element MUST be of kind 'Halt'.

num_registers.description: Number of register cells the program declares.

num_cursors.description: Number of cursor slots the program declares.

num_sorters.description: Phase 6b: number of sorter slots the program declares. 0 for programs without ORDER BY.
